message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout that caught me off guard. I was in the middle of my favorite show when the lights flickered and then went dark. My first thought? I grabbed my trusty flashlight and powered up the family group chat to see who else was affected. It turned into a fun exchange of tips on keeping our phones charged and sharing cozy snack ideas with the fridge being our temporary best friend. It’s amazing how a little tech can keep us connected and comfortable, even in the dark! What’s your go-to for staying cozy during a power outage?
